title: Highland Harvest and Field Songs (Ki Rwaimar bad Jingrwai Ot Kba)
khasi_title: Ki Rwaimar bad Jingrwai Ot Kba
cultural_context: Call-and-response work songs sung collectively by men and women while harvesting golden terrace paddy fields (ot kba) and carrying heavy bamboo baskets (khoh) up steep mountain trails.
lyrics_khasi:
Sngi ba bhabriew ha lyngkha ba jyrngam,
Ot ïa u kba ba la stem bha halor lum,
Thep ha ka shang, thep ha ka khoh,
Wanrah sha ïing ban pynsuk ïa ka kpoh!

Hoi-ia-hoi! Ot beit ko samla!
Ka lyiur ka la leit, u tlang u la wan,
Pynkhalai ia ka rashi ba nep,
Ngin ioh bam ja-khasi ha la ka tnum!
lyrics_english:
Glorious is the sunny day in green terraced fields,
Reap the golden paddy ripe upon the mountainside,
Pack it into the small basket, heave it into the tall cone basket,
Carry it home to nourish the household hearth!

Hoi-ia-hoi! Reap on steadily, brave youths!
The summer rains have passed, crisp winter has arrived,
Sweep the sharp curved sickle through the grain,
We shall feast on indigenous sweet rice under our roof!

stanzas.title: Ka Jing-ot Kba (Reaping the Ripe Grain)
stanzas.khasi:
Sngi ba bhabriew ha lyngkha ba jyrngam,
Ot ïa u kba ba la stem bha halor lum,
Thep ha ka shang, thep ha ka khoh,
Wanrah sha ïing ban pynsuk ïa ka kpoh!
stanzas.english: Beautiful sunny day on green fields! Cut the ripe golden mountain paddy, fill the conical baskets, bring it home to nourish the family!

vocabulary.khoh: Conical Khasi carrying basket woven of split bamboo and supported by a headstrap (u star)
vocabulary.shang: Flat shallow bamboo basket for winnowing grain
